⚑ Same-squad gate roster: the kit says 'an ally from the same squad' but names nobody. Which slugs satisfy it is roster data I am blind to (data/characters.json), so the test asserts only that SOME gate exists on the heal block and that it is INACTIVE in controlComp — it cannot verify the slug list is the right one. Recipe: read the unit's squad membership from characters.json / the wiki and check teamHas.slugs covers exactly those.

⚑ Duration discrimination is structural, not behavioral: the 5/10/15/25s windows are asserted by reading durationSec off the override clone, because buff-window length is not separable from the totals in a 180s fight with overlapping re-applies. A behavioral check would need event timestamps (the log's time field name is not documented in the packet).

Burst group is fixture-conditional: if crown always wins the shared stage-2 slot, her burstCast count is 0 and the burst assertions fail. That failure is a real fixture finding (needs a comp where she is the sole Burst II), not a defect in the override — the test states this explicitly rather than skipping quietly.
The 3.04%/40.18% Max-HP heal MAGNITUDES are unrepresentable (the `heal` effect models no HP amount), so only tick structure and the recovery channel are verifiable.
